text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you good at art?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Me? Well... Let me tell you what
happened while
we were drawing our
friends during art class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My friend took one look at my work and
asked,
"Is this an alien or something?"
Can you imagine?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Surely you know... what this means?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My artistic prowess extends beyond the
very stars
themselves! All hail Superstar
Artist Bakushin!
